# equinix_fabric_ip_blocks (Data Source)

Fabric V4 API compatible data resource that allows users to search for Equinix Fabric IP Blocks with pagination details.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/IP-Blocks



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (Attributes) Filters for the Data Source Search Request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Optional

- `pagination` (Attributes) Pagination details for the returned IP blocks list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagination))
- `sort` (Attributes) Sort criteria for the Data Source Search Request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sort))

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Returned list of IP block objects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Operator to use on your filtered field with the values given. One of: [=, !=, >, >=, <, <=, IN, NOT IN, LIKE, NOT LIKE, IS NOT NULL, IS NULL]
- `property` (String) Field name to use on filters
- `values` (List of String) The values that you want to apply the property+operator combination to in order to filter your data search


<a id="nestedatt--pagination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pagination`

Optional:

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of search results returned per page. Number must be between 1 and 100, and the default is 20
- `offset` (Number) Index of the first item returned in the response. The default is 0

Read-Only:

- `next` (String) The URL relative to the next item in the response
- `previous` (String) The URL relative to the previous item in the response
- `total` (Number) The total number of IP blocks available to the user making the request


<a id="nestedatt--sort"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sort`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) The sorting direction. Can be one of: [DESC, ASC], Defaults to DESC
- `property` (String) The property name to use in sorting. One of "/uuid" "/state" "/prefixLength" "/changeLog/createdDateTime" "/changeLog/updatedDateTime". Defaults to "/changeLog/updatedDateTime"


<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `account` (Attributes) Account associated with the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--account))
- `assets` (Attributes List) List of assets (connections or services) using this IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--assets))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Audit log of changes to the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the IP block resource
- `location` (Attributes) Location of the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--location))
- `order` (Attributes) Order details for the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--order))
- `ownership` (String) Ownership of the IP block. One of: EQUINIX, CUSTOMER
- `prefix` (String) The assigned IP prefix (e.g. 192.0.2.0/24)
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the IP block (e.g. 24 for a /24 block)
- `project` (Attributes) Project associated with the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--project))
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the IP block
- `type` (String) Type of the IP block product
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the IP block

<a id="nestedatt--data--account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.account`

Read-Only:

- `account_number` (String) Account number
